invariants.rationale: The method always returns a value constructed by calling clone on a non-null metadata object.
metadata is required to invoke clone and getWriteStatuses.
The clone method is called, which should return a new object, not the same reference.
The returned result is of type HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so getWriteStatuses returns a List.
getWriteStatuses is accessed to construct the return value, implying it is non-null at this point.
